lines.text: David fled from Saul into the cave and said his soul takes refuge in God.
David will shelter in the shadow of God's wings until the danger has passed, crying out to God Most High.
David's soul is among the lions, with men whose teeth are spears, and he asks God to be exalted above the mountains.
David says his enemies dug a pit and fell into it, and he calls his harp and lyre to awake.
David will praise the Lord among the nations because God's loving devotion reaches to the treetops.
